d: Long, flowing platinum white hair with sweeping bangs frames a youthful face with sharp, narrow amber eyes. The slender build is dressed in a black school-style blazer and matching pleated skirt worn over a white underskirt, complemented by a white collared shirt, a red necktie, black tights, and black buckled boots. Two katanas are strapped to the back, with one blade partially visible and extending downward.
